claim_summary: The work couples an LLM control planner with TimesFM and contributes counterfactual forecast perturbation and deterministic risk-based filtering of proposed industrial control actions.

claim_evidence.quote: We introduce a Counterfactual Physics Injection mechanism that translates LLM-generated semantic control actions into numerical perturbations of future forecasts. This enables deterministic validation of the proposed actions without finetuning the foundation model.

modules.name: Counterfactual physics injection
modules.scope_reason: R3_1_TSK applies because the injection embeds the control-action objective in a tank-level forecast; if the task family changed, the actuator semantics and intervention equation would need redesign. The series-valued forecast perturbation is a task-specific procedure, not a general temporal processor (counterfactual).
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:yes - embeds task-specific control actions in the forecast

evidence.quote: The fundamental contribution of this work is the Physics Injection Function Φ(Ŷ , ci ) that translates the semantic command ci into a numerical perturbation of TimesFM forecast ( the model’s internal state cannot be directly modified).

modules.name: Risk-based intervention rejection and selection
modules.scope_reason: R3_1_TSK applies because feasibility rules and minimizing the maximum projected tank level encode the specific control objective; changing task family requires redesigning the action space, actuator constraints, and risk criterion. Forecast-risk evaluation is task-specific processing (counterfactual: a reusable general validator would not need these water-control rules).
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:yes - embeds tank-control feasibility and projected-risk criteria

process_validity.quote: No hallucinated action was ever executed (column “Hallucinated Action Executed” in Table III is False for all trials). The decomposition across attack types is approximately uniform; full per-trial categorical logs are maintained in the experimental artifact.

task_performance.quote: The Neuro-Agentic model succeeded in preventing breach in five of 15 trials (33.3%), which is between 26.7% (4/15) of LSTM and 13.3% (2/15) of TCN.

decision_utility.quote: We define two key metrics for assessing the performance of the neuro-agentic framework: 1) Risk Reduction (∆R), the quantitative difference between the Passive Forecast peak and the Agent-Mitigated peak.

changes: split counterfactual forecast perturbation from feasibility checking and risk-based rejection/selection
rename retained module to Counterfactual physics injection
replace legacy dimensions with Tools and Execution
add Planning and Orchestration dimension to new rejection/selection module
add temporal function processing to both task procedures
reconciliation.reason: The existing card groups bounded proposal/forecast perturbation, while the packet specifies a distinct Physics Injection Function and a separately formulated feasibility and projected-risk selection procedure. They are separately describable mechanisms; retain the existing id for forecast injection and add a new id for rejection/selection.

notes: The paper evaluates attack scenarios as inputs to a water-treatment control policy; its reported output is a control decision, so decision_support is the supported task family. The stated train/validation/test proportions do not establish chronological or leakage-safe evaluation.
